useDataTableState

A hook that provides handlers for DataTable pagination, sorting, and row selection.

Example
import useDataTableState from '@/utils/hooks/useDataTableState'
import DataTable from '@/components/shared/DataTable'

const TableComponent = () => {
    const [tableData, setTableData] = useState({
        pageIndex: 1,
        pageSize: 10,
        sortOrder: '',
        sortKey: '',
    })
    const [selectedRows, setSelectedRows] = useState([])

    const {
        onPaginationChange,
        onPageSizeChange,
        onSort,
        onRowSelect,
        onAllRowSelect,
    } = useDataTableState({
        pagingState: tableData,
        onPagingChange: setTableData,
        selectedRows,
        onRowSelectionChange: (checked, row) => {
            // Handle single row selection
        },
        onAllRowSelectChange: setSelectedRows,
    })

    return (
        <DataTable
            columns={columns}
            data={data}
            onPaginationChange={onPaginationChange}
            onSelectChange={onPageSizeChange}
            onSort={onSort}
            onCheckBoxChange={onRowSelect}
            onIndeterminateCheckBoxChange={onAllRowSelect}
        />
    )
}

Params
PARAM	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
pagingState	Current table query state (pageIndex, pageSize, sortOrder, sortKey).	TableQueries	-
onPagingChange	Callback when paging state changes.	(data: TableQueries) => void	-
selectedRows	Currently selected rows.	Partial<T>[]	-
onRowSelectionChange	Callback when a single row selection changes.	(checked: boolean, row: T) => void	-
onAllRowSelectChange	Callback when all rows selection changes.	(rows: T[]) => void	-
RETURN	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
onPaginationChange	Handler for page changes.	(page: number) => void	-
onPageSizeChange	Handler for page size changes.	(value: number) => void	-
onSort	Handler for sort changes.	(sort: { sortOrder, sortKey }) => void	-
onRowSelect	Handler for single row selection.	(checked: boolean, row: T) => void	-
onAllRowSelect	Handler for all rows selection.	(checked: boolean, rows: Row<T>[]) => void	-
